record.context_brief: Primitive binary cyclic codes with d=3
record.original_question: Give a complete description of primitive binary cyclic codes of minimum distance three; the chapter reports only partial classifications and says the full description remained open.

evidence.quote: However the whole description of cyclic codes of minimum distance three remains an open, and apparently, difficult problem.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A binary cyclic code of length n = 2^m − 1 is called primitive: it is an ideal in the ring F_2[x]/(x^n − 1), and can be specified by its set of zeros, namely a union of 2-cyclotomic cosets modulo n, where each zero is a power α^i of a fixed primitive n-th root of unity α in F_{2^m}. The minimum distance of the code is the smallest Hamming weight of a nonzero codeword. 

Problem: Give a complete classification of all primitive binary cyclic codes of length n = 2^m − 1 (for all m ≥ 2) whose minimum distance equals exactly 3. Equivalently, determine all unions S of 2-cyclotomic cosets modulo 2^m − 1 such that the cyclic code with zero set {α^i : i ∈ S} has minimum distance precisely 3, in a closed-form / explicit description covering every m.
artifact.status_search_result: A complete classification of primitive binary cyclic codes with minimum distance 3 is not known. Partial results exist (notably by Charpin, Tietäväinen, and Zinoviev, "On binary cyclic codes with minimum distance three", Problems of Information Transmission 33 (1997)), connecting the problem to questions about exponential sums and APN-like properties, but no full description has been published. Recent works (e.g., new constructions and bounds on cyclic codes through 2024–2025) continue to address related parameters without giving a complete classification.

status_evidence.title: On binary cyclic codes with minimum distance d=3
status_evidence.snippet: Charpin, Tietäväinen, Zinoviev — partial classification of binary cyclic codes with minimum distance three.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial classification results are available; no complete description is known.

status_evidence.title: Open problems on cyclic codes
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys cyclic-code open problems including the d=3 classification, listed as open.
status_evidence.claim: The full classification of primitive binary cyclic codes of minimum distance 3 is listed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: New Constructions of Binary Cyclic Codes
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) constructions of binary cyclic codes; does not provide a full d=3 classification.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent research has not produced a complete description.
